preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
For each test case, the number of rooms n must be greater than the number of friends k, with n not exceeding 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= x_i <= n for x_i in friends)
preconditions.description: Each friend's room number x_i must be between 2 and n, and all x_i must be distinct.
The number of corridors must be exactly n - 1, forming a tree structure.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' for each test case.
If Vlad can guarantee victory, the output must be 'YES'.

postconditions.expression: not any(vlad_can_win for vlad_can_win in results)
postconditions.description: If Vlad cannot guarantee victory, the output must be 'NO'.
